intro: Between April and July 2026, ZCyberNews covered 59 social-engineering incidents, with ClickFix, Lazarus Group, and UNC6692 among the most frequently observed threat actors. Key vulnerabilities exploited included CVE-2023-36036, CVE-2025-24054, CVE-2025-33053, and CVE-2026-21513, while the financial services, cryptocurrency, technology, and government sectors bore the brunt of attacks. The severity mix comprised 45 high, 11 medium, 2 informational, and 1 critical report, with impacts spanning North America, Europe, the United States, Australia, and globally.
